assessment.securityAndPrivacy: SafeError remains the source for per-file failures; unknown errors omit raw bodies. No new networking, authority, dependencies or credential handling. Overflow response carries no partial contents. Cooperative cancellation remains covered before work and after read awaits.
assessment.resourceOwnership: No new product resources. Installed fixture lives beneath owned temporary scope; launcher and server are independently checked for exit before removal. Missing/invalid PID makes cleanup fail and retain fixture instead of claiming process cleanup. Junction and hardlink negative fixtures are task-owned.
assessment.testQuality: Tests use a literal response-format oracle and exact aggregate byte computations, not the implementation counter. Boundary fixtures exercise summary-only bypasses and separator/error contributions. Original corrected RED fails real assertions on baseline; GREEN uses the same fixture bytes.
assessment.portability: Fixture roots use fs.realpath, UTF8 filenames/content and platform-specific junction creation already supported by suite. Actual native/hosted execution is not inferred from inspection.
